name: Frontera Funds SKaaS — FIC Funds Intelligence
description: Portable Frontera Funds-branded institutional analysis and HTML reporting Skill for Colombian FICs, using host-provided authorized data capabilities and optional dated categorization snapshots.
author: Jairo Alonso González

service_profile.service_outcome: Produce an evidence-led, standardized Spanish-language HTML factsheet or peer-comparison report for Colombian collective investment funds, supported by structured findings and source provenance.

separate_library_when: substantial reusable data-processing or analytics functionality is needed
functionality requires independent release and maintenance

integration_requirements.access_policy: The host verifies source access, licensing, entitlements and permissions for each invocation. The Skill declares data capabilities; the host maps available integrations to those requirements. No specific MCP, connector, API vendor or private SaaS implementation is bundled or required.

output_contract.consistency_policy: Required report profile sections, metric definitions, cutoff, provenance, category treatment, disclosures and validation remain stable across compatible models. Narrative analysis may differ but must follow evidence and uncertainty rules.

model_portability.target: Compatible Agent Skills hosts and models
model_portability.guarantee: Standardized service contract, report structures and validation expectations; not identical model reasoning or prose.

commercialization.separation_policy: The Skill, data access and managed service are independently packageable and commercial components. The portable Skill does not include hosted data access, execution infrastructure, support, pricing or SLA unless separately contracted.
commercialization.pricing_and_terms: Defined separately by the product owner; not specified in this manifest.

runtime_requirements.python: optional for the lightweight HTML artifact validator; not required to read the methodology or reason over supplied data
runtime_requirements.network: required only for live external source retrieval
runtime_requirements.file_generation: requires writable host artifact capability or a user-supplied HTML artifact
runtime_requirements.external_data_access: authorized public data, MCP, API, browser, user-supplied file or licensed provider

branding.identity_standard: Frontera Funds factsheet reference identity and canonical light institutional report design system
branding.logo_policy: Use the bundled reference mark extracted from the user-supplied factsheet HTML at skills/fic-funds-intelligence/assets/frontera-funds-mark.svg paired with the Frontera Funds text wordmark. This is a user-supplied reference asset, not independently trademark-verified.
branding.implementation_boundary: Brand and report-quality consistency do not imply code, API, infrastructure, credential or runtime dependency on the private Frontera Funds SaaS.
branding.logo_asset_type: user-supplied Frontera Funds factsheet reference SVG mark
branding.logo_lockup: Pair the official mark with the Frontera Funds text wordmark; do not invent a combined graphic.
branding.asset_license: Frontera Funds brand asset; excluded from the package's MIT code license. Use only for authorized Frontera Funds product distribution.
branding.trademark_notice: Frontera Funds name, logo and brand identity remain the property of their owner.

data_dependencies.name: SFC FIC open-data dataset qhpu-8ixx
data_dependencies.freshness: Capture latest cutoff and retrieval time on every live-data invocation

data_dependencies.name: FIC categorization snapshot
data_dependencies.freshness: Use snapshot's own cutoff and version; never assume latest is current without verification

evaluation.report_ref: Local validation after revision: 12 tests passed; factsheet and comparative example payloads validated against the domain schema.
limitations: Domain analysis quality and investment suitability are not certified.
evaluation.scope: 12 local package tests passed; both example payloads validate against the Draft 2020-12 report schema. Full factory CI, registry schema validation, live data integration and cross-model runtime validation remain pending.

runtime_compatibility.surface: Native Skill discovery and optional tool integration
Standard-library HTML artifact validator and package tests
